bf-a561f569dacbef352f9ffb95.what: Manual source-watcher startup threw AsyncFiberError, blocking source and scaffold reload admission.
bf-a561f569dacbef352f9ffb95.root_cause: startDevSourceWatcher in dev-watch.ts ran session.nativeEngine.watch synchronously. That effect in dev-session-engine.ts begins with ownedNativePromise importing dev-watch.js, which must suspend even when the module is cached. Effect.runSync correctly rejects suspended work.
bf-a561f569dacbef352f9ffb95.fixed_by: Add a narrow internal watchWith operation that supplies the existing engine authorities and Scope to an already-loaded watcher effect. The synchronous facade uses it directly; the normal CLI watch effect continues importing lazily and then uses the same owner. Preserve the public watcher return type and supervisor API.
